class.name: LRTGeometryBinding3D
class.brief_description: Binds a mesh instance to its own object-space Color SDF resource.
class.description: Place this node directly under a [MeshInstance3D]. The parent mesh and its effective materials define the bake; the binding's own transform is ignored. The parent must use Dynamic GI mode to contribute through its Color SDF. Different material instances require separate baked resources. Select this node and use [b]Bake LRT Color SDF[/b] in the 3D toolbar, or call [method bake]. The bake includes two sample cells of padding and supports closed, consistently oriented triangle meshes with opaque UV-mapped [StandardMaterial3D] or [ORMMaterial3D] materials, including material overrides, vertex colors, metallic diffuse reduction and fixed emission. Open, non-manifold, skinned or deformed meshes and unsupported material features fail explicitly without replacing the previous bake. [b]Development status:[/b] ShaderMaterial, triplanar, detail layers, transparency, refraction, extra material passes and runtime geometry composition are not implemented yet.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes the parent instance in object space and saves the result to a binary [code].res[/code] resource. Assigns [member bake_data] only after a successful save. Returns [constant OK] on success, [constant ERR_SKIP] when canceled, or an error code. LRT builds the engine triangle BVH without vertex snapping and uses double-precision triangle predicates to retain thin imported faces. The binding transform and parent world transform do not affect the bake.

method.name: get_geometry_instance
method.description: Returns the parent mesh instance, or null when this binding is not a direct child of a MeshInstance3D.

members.member: Object-space geometry cache for this instance. Mesh or material edits require rebaking; moving the instance does not.
Sample count along the longest Color SDF axis. Other axes are proportional. Includes two cells of padding at each end; must be at least 6.
